Each profile shows a player's season to date: pitch grades and arsenal for pitchers, swing decisions and contact quality for Triple-A hitters, league percentiles, and how each number moved through the season. Players are listed by last name with their team and level. To compare players instead, use the [pitch-grade leaderboard](/baseball/tools/stuff-leaderboard.html) or the [Triple-A explorer](/baseball/tools/triple-a.html).
